outer: fixed binary [256,128] code with a supplied spectrum; independent output-coordinate permutation per outer block
permutation: transpose to 256 regions and independently permute the 8192 bits in every region
inner: 64 parallel accumulator lanes; after each 32 batches of 32 bits, multiply the state by the transpose of an independent uniform nonzero GF(2^64) multiplier

proof_status.uniform_r_subset_epoch_transfer: exact coefficient formula and brute-force validation

claim_scope: The outer spectrum is a modeled BCH-like [256,128,38] profile. The 9% full-occupation first-moment route fails in the middle-density range. At 6%, all regular occupations and the one-all-one layer are covered numerically, but configurations with at least two all-one words below the dense threshold and outward rounding remain open.
